response.sql: WITH pattern_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg FROM pattern_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_acl_igg, p.avg_acl_igg - o.mean_avg AS above_overall_mean FROM pattern_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE p.avg_acl_igg > o.mean_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_acl_igg, k.above_overall_mean, k.avg_acl_igg - m.mean_avg AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m;
